description: Work out the fill of EMT, IMC, RMC or PVC Schedule 40 or 80 from NFPA 70 (NEC) 2023 Chapter 9: Table 5 conductor areas, Table 4 raceway area, and Table 1 allowed percent (53% for one conductor, 31% for two, 40% for more than two, or 60% for a nipple 24 in or shorter). Mixed sizes are allowed. Verify the result with the edition your AHJ has adopted.

conductors.description: One conductor group per line, e.g. '6 x 4 AWG THHN'

conduit.description: emt, imc, rmc, pvc40 or pvc80

nipple.description: If true, use 60% fill for a nipple 24 in (600 mm) or shorter

trade_size.description: Trade size such as 1/2, 3/4, 1, 1-1/4. Omit to get the smallest size that fits.

name: conduit_fill
title: Conduit fill from NEC Chapter 9 Tables 1, 4 and 5
